firstNightReminder: Point to the grandchild player & show their character token.
otherNightReminder: If the grandchild was killed by the Demon, the Grandmother dies too. :reminder:

en.name: Grandmother
en.ability: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
en.flavor: Take a jacket if you go outside, dearie. And your thermos. And your scarf. I have a weak heart, you know. Whatever would I do if you caught cold...or worse?
